nvitk.core¶

Public core API: NumPy/CuPy backend switching, array helpers, and proxy setup.

Typical GPU-aware code:

from nvitk.core import setup, get_current_backend
setup(globals())

def f(x):
    return np.asarray(x)  # np follows active backend after setup

nvitk.core.as_backend_array(arr: Any, backend: str | None = None, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False) → Any¶

Convert arr to NumPy or CuPy using get_current_backend() when backend is None.

Parameters:

  • arr – Any array-like or CuPy/NumPy array.

  • backend – numpy/cpu/np or cupy/gpu/cp; default follows current context.

  • copy – Force a copy on conversion.

  • strict – For CuPy: raise BackendUnavailableError if CuPy missing.

Raises:

ValueError – Unknown backend string.

nvitk.core.ensure_same_backend(*arrays: Any, backend: str | None = None) → tuple[Any, Ellipsis]¶

Apply as_backend_array() to each input with the same backend (or current).

True if arr is a cupy.ndarray.

nvitk.core.is_numpy_array(arr: Any) → bool¶

True if arr is a numpy.ndarray.

nvitk.core.to_cupy(arr: Any, copy: bool = False, strict: bool = False)¶

Move arr to CuPy, or return NumPy array if strict is False and CuPy is unavailable.

Parameters:

strict – If True, raise BackendUnavailableError when CuPy cannot load.

Materialize arr on CPU as numpy.ndarray (get() for CuPy).

class nvitk.core.using(backend_name: str, allow_fallback: bool = True)¶

Context manager for scoped backend switching (updates contextvars.ContextVar).

Examples

with using("cupy"):
    x = np.array([1])  # CuPy array module

class nvitk.core.BackendProxy(module_name: str)¶

Lazily bind np, scipy, ndi in a module’s globals() to the active backend.

On refresh_globals(), inserts either NumPy/SciPy or CuPy/cupyx equivalents. Unknown attribute access forwards to the active array module (proxy.np).

module_name¶
_cached_backend: str | None = None¶
_cached_modules: tuple[Any, Any, Any] | None = None¶
_module_globals: dict[str, Any] | None = None¶
_resolve_modules() → tuple[Any, Any, Any]¶

Return the (array, scipy, ndimage) triple for the active backend, cached per backend.

bind_globals(module_globals: dict[str, Any]) → None¶

Store module_globals and populate np/scipy/ndi keys.

invalidate() → None¶

Drop cached backend tuple so the next access re-reads get_current_backend().

refresh_globals() → None¶

Write current (np, scipy, ndi) triple into bound module globals.

property np: Any¶

Active array module — NumPy on the CPU backend, CuPy on the GPU backend.

property scipy: Any¶

Active SciPy module — scipy or cupyx.scipy.

property ndi: Any¶

Active n-d image module — scipy.ndimage or cupyx.scipy.ndimage.

__getattr__(name: str) → Any¶

Forward any unknown attribute to the active array module (so proxy.zeros works).

nvitk.core.get_backend_proxy(module_name: str | None = None) → BackendProxy¶

Return (or create) the BackendProxy keyed by module_name.

If module_name is omitted, uses the caller’s __name__ via the stack.
